cards.name: Gummies
cards.text: Pour your own gummies, pull them out of the mold, add chocolate and sour sugar, then heat-seal them in a pouch.

cards.name: Arbuz Express
cards.text: A monkey drives a watermelon train and you steer it, in glorious 240p, across five cursed TV channels.

cards.name: Apogee
cards.text: A Mac browser that blocks every ad, cleans up YouTube and answers your questions on a drawn board.

cards.name: Wire Choir
cards.text: Type a line and glowing heads sing it, every tongue and jaw movement driven by a real model of the human throat.

cards.name: Gzowo StarNet
cards.text: Every project on this site hangs in one net. Pick what you like and everything that does not fit drops out.

cards.name: Beam
cards.text: Projection mapping as a game: trace the frames and shelves on your wall, then run and jump across them in neon.

cards.name: Odd Herd
cards.text: A pixel art co-op platformer for 1 to 4 players online: pick one of ten animals and get the whole herd through the door.

cards.name: Ghostbusters
cards.text: Suit up at the Ecto-1 with up to three friends, blast a greedy ghost, wrangle it together and drag it into a trap.

cards.name: Instalator
cards.text: Kit out real houses with real smart home gear: the TV shows a dollhouse, your phones are the tools.

cards.name: Rybna Wyspa
cards.text: Build a fish farm with friends on a small island in the Narew: pumps, belts, flumes, machines and a riverside fish fry.

cards.name: Stillvale
cards.text: A quiet walk through an alpine valley: tall grass, a still lake and birdsong. Keep an eye on the timer.

cards.name: Robotea
cards.text: Your webcam turns your hands into a robot's hands: high-five another robot, or make finger guns and hit the range.

cards.name: Ghostframe
cards.text: Pose see-through ghosts of Tesla Optimus around a stage and watch it walk and jump through every in-between frame.

cards.name: Rug Rush
cards.text: Unload rug trucks, read the care labels and wash every rug in a co-op warehouse without ruining the silk.

cards.name: Fabrics
cards.text: Pull curtains, fly flags, drape robes and scrunch rugs, then cut, burn, dye and blow on real-time cloth.

cards.name: Roadster Jump
cards.text: Suction the Roadster up a giant curled ramp, hang from the ceiling, then kickflip off the lip on cold-gas jets.

cards.name: Spillway
cards.text: Draw gutters with a limited marker and pump your colour of water into its cup, alone or with up to three friends online.

cards.name: Mirage
cards.text: Put on smart glasses, call drones down from orbit and project a dragon, a whale or outer space over Venice.

cards.name: Timeblock
cards.text: Drop in a video and it turns into a block of time cast in sanded resin, where every frame is a slice.

cards.name: Speak & Groove
cards.text: Type a letter and a robot voice spells it through a big reverb, then a techno band joins in behind you.

cards.name: Toot Tube
cards.text: Up to three animals hang on to one inflatable ring and steer it down a spiky river the only way they can: by farting.

cards.name: Cutlery
cards.text: Fork, Knife and Butter find their way back to the breakfast table, each one a tool the others need.

cards.name: Kindling
cards.text: Stick monsters crawl out of a cornfield. Cut them apart with a laser, jump the iron wall and feed the fire.

cards.name: Campfire
cards.text: Sit by a campfire in a dark forest: stack logs, stir the embers, toast a marshmallow or put it all out.

cards.name: Cube Breakers
cards.text: Shoot balls that bounce forever into a giant cube of blocks, together with everyone who is online.

cards.name: Roadster 88
cards.text: Drive, boost and fly the 2026 Tesla Roadster on ten cold-gas thrusters, then hit 88 mph and jump through time.

cards.name: Wolisz?!
cards.text: A 2D online sandbox where every would-you-rather question gives your avatar a power, and the powers pile up.

cards.name: Make Your Own Game, I'm Lazy
cards.text: Draw a tree, a hero and a gun, say what game you want, and an AI writes it around your drawings.

cards.name: Foamwalker
cards.text: A hunched purple alien with a human face crawls through a foam-block maze.

cards.name: iPhone Duo
cards.text: A semi-realistic virtual clone of the iPhone Duo

cards.name: Wordshader
cards.text: Type a line of words and watch a glowing 3D blob and its soundtrack appear letter by letter, then export the loop as a video.

cards.name: Timberline Express
cards.text: Survive an endless mountain forest by turning a hand-pumped rail cart into a steam-powered, house-sized train.

cards.name: Haystack Inc.
cards.text: Somewhere in a stack of a million straws there is one needle. Dig by hand, then build the machines that dig for you.

cards.name: Hello Miner
cards.text: Program mining drones in a tiny Python-like language and automate a floating quarry together with friends in real time.

cards.name: Gzowo Glass
cards.text: Home-built smart glasses with a see-through HUD and a voice assistant that talks back in Polish.

cards.name: Squish
cards.text: A silent paper-white void full of squishies and fidget toys you can actually squeeze, crack and stretch.

cards.name: Doodle Run
cards.text: A 2D runner where you draw every single thing in it first, then rig your scribbles so they walk, flap and chase you.

cards.name: Smendilendi Bureau
cards.text: Run a tiny architecture practice with your friends, draw the walls, take the client's notes, then walk the finished building thirty years later.

cards.name: Mark Zero
cards.text: Fly a powered armor suit at the speed of sound, six degrees of freedom, no rails, no limits.

cards.name: Noclip
cards.text: A found-footage Backrooms experience, you fall in, something tall follows, and the tape keeps rolling.

cards.name: Voidworks
cards.text: A factory hanging in white nothing. Droppers, belts, upgraders, and a hard cap on how much can be moving at once.

cards.name: Ducks
cards.text: Feed rubber ducks to a hungry pit, then build the machines that do it for you.

cards.name: Hollowtree
cards.text: One to three players, each of them a queen bee, sharing one hive inside a hollow tree.

cards.name: Narew Labs
cards.text: Chat with a language model trained from scratch, running on a MacBook, reached from anywhere.

cards.name: SKI Together
cards.text: A day at a ski resort for two to five people, on snow that remembers every turn you carved.

cards.name: Smendiłendi
cards.text: A printed robot dog on four servos and an ESP32, the first project here whose output is a physical object.

cards.name: Gzowo Builders
cards.text: Build a vehicle out of blocks, wheels and pistons, then drive it until something snaps off.

cards.name: Airwave
cards.text: An instrument you play with your hands in the air, in front of a webcam. No hardware.

cards.name: Voxel Demolition
cards.text: A destruction sandbox with twenty-five tools and co-op for four. Runs on a server at home.

cards.name: Gargantua
cards.text: Co-op zero-gravity spacewalk next to a black hole. Push off carefully; there is no brake.

cards.name: Cruise Control
cards.text: A precision driving game with retro pixel post-processing, moving hazards and a shop.

cards.name: Untitled Pogo Game
cards.text: Fifteen levels of pogo-stick parkour, playable together, installable as an app.

cards.name: Backrooms
cards.text: Yellow rooms, buzzing lights, and a maze that does not care whether you get out.

cards.name: GSP Brand Kit
cards.text: The visual identity behind GSP, logo, colours and type, in one page you can download from.

cards.name: Gzowo Bowling
cards.text: Bowling on a laptop, thrown with a phone. Scan the code and your phone becomes the ball.

cards.name: Modular
cards.text: Drop sixteen kinds of building on a plot and watch a town assemble itself around them.

cards.name: Galeria Gzowo
cards.text: A gallery for the place the rest of this site is named after.

cards.name: Narew
cards.text: One real property by the Narew: paddle it, dig it, ride a jet ski through it, or watch TV indoors.

cards.name: Kontemplujący Beethoven
cards.text: Beethoven, the deaf white cat, greets the sun over the misty Narew.

cards.name: Logo Gzowo 34
cards.text: The white octopus on black.

cards.name: The Orange Beauty
cards.text: Jurek's rocket in full glory, shot at 0.5x from below.

cards.name: Jurek z Dropsikiem
cards.text: A summer hug with the dog.

cards.name: Malowanie Światłem
cards.text: Painting with light by the campfire, on a long exposure.

cards.name: Stara tablica ośrodka FSO
cards.text: Fabryka Samochodów Osobowych, Ośrodek Wędkarski w Gzowie. A keepsake from the old resort.

cards.name: Waldek pozuje z helikopterem
cards.text: A navy Airbus, SP-MMM, landed on the bluff in 2022. Kropka the dog guards the skid.

cards.name: Jan Sukiennik z kozą nad Narwią
cards.text: The Resort Manager in his white fur, with the goat that stayed for one Christmas.

cards.name: Wieżowiec gotów do startu
cards.text: Ready for launch, 100%. The perfect cover for a new Beatles album.

cards.name: Gzofajfus Classic Mk IV
cards.text: Lying on the meadow after a great success, parachute still attached.

cards.name: Pilot Jan
cards.text: Controller in hand, out in nature.

cards.name: Luna
cards.text: A quiet night and a lonely moon.

cards.name: Słońce nad polem
cards.text: Jurek experiences a sunset.

cards.name: Klucz Ptaków
cards.text: Birds coming back across the spring sky.

cards.name: Zimowy Obiad Jurka
cards.text: Mmm, yummy!

cards.name: Strike a pose!
cards.text: A little Superman in the spotlight!

cards.name: Domek nr 1
cards.text: A dark wooden cabin with a red door, from the old FSO resort. Three of ten are left.

cards.name: Architektoniczny wieżowiec
cards.text: Dad's 3D printed rocket, built and styled like a skyscraper.

cards.name: Wieżowiec gotów do startu V2
cards.text: Jurek sets the rocket up on the gravel road. Ready, 100%.

cards.name: Dron w chmurach
cards.text: The Avata in flight.

cards.name: Rysio na desce SUP
cards.text: Rysio is having a great time on the SUP!

cards.name: Krowi chłopiec
cards.text: Resting in the yard together (alligator included).

cards.name: Czytanie w Domu
cards.text: A lazy day on the couch.

cards.name: Zimowy Obiad Rysia
cards.text: Mmm, yummy!

cards.name: Rakieta na wyrzutni
cards.text: On the pad in the middle of a flat meadow, under a cloudy sky.

cards.name: Dwie rakiety na tle próbek
cards.text: Two printed rockets, dark green and light green, in front of the filament samples.

cards.name: Warsztat rakietowy
cards.text: Green rockets and parts, mid-assembly under the pegboard.

cards.name: Mapa geodezyjna działki
cards.text: The survey map, photographed a month before the plot became the Sukienniks'.

cards.name: Narew
cards.text: Reeds in the shallows, blue sky, the far bank a long way off.

cards.name: Plaża
cards.text: The sandy slope down to the water, where the kayaks and the SUP go in.

cards.name: Szyszka
cards.text: The pine cone money of Gzowo. Earned on the plot, never bought.

cards.name: GSP Rocket
cards.text: Press START, count down from ten, and it comes back on a parachute.

cards.name: Gzowo St. Exchange
cards.text: GZM and GZF rise and fall with the Narew and the wind.

cards.name: StarNet Planetarium
cards.text: Every project in one net of stars.

cards.name: Launch Pad
cards.text: Where every rocket on the plot begins.

cards.name: Arcade
cards.text: All the games live here.

cards.name: Lab
cards.text: Software and AI, with a dish on the roof.

cards.name: Workshop
cards.text: Home of the 3D printers.

cards.name: GSP Hangar
cards.text: Open the doors and look at the fleet.

cards.name: Museum
cards.text: Paint a picture, let Haiku judge it, sell it for szyszki.

cards.name: Coaster Station
cards.text: A ride in the clouds over Gzowo Street.

cards.name: Card Kiosk
cards.text: You are holding what it sells.

cards.name: Claw Machine
cards.text: Three free tries a day. The claw has opinions.

cards.name: Sun
cards.text: Shines over the plot until a cloud gets clicked.

cards.name: Store
cards.text: Fireworks, balloons and outfits, all for szyszki.

cards.name: Cork Board
cards.text: Pin a note or a drawing. It hangs for a week.

cards.name: Changing Booth
cards.text: New outfit? Looking good.

cards.name: Sailboat
cards.text: Drifts down the Narew all day.

cards.name: Seagull
cards.text: Watches the river. Judges quietly.

cards.name: Dock
cards.text: Click it to go fishing.

cards.name: Mailbox
cards.text: The guestbook. Leave a message.

cards.name: Billboard
cards.text: A random visitor review in big letters.

cards.name: Signpost
cards.text: Points at what this place is about.

cards.name: Bench
cards.text: A good seat for watching rockets.

cards.name: Street Lamp
cards.text: Lights the way down Gzowo Street.

cards.name: Pine
cards.text: Where szyszki come from.

cards.name: Tree
cards.text: Changes with the season.

cards.name: Windsock
cards.text: Shows which way the wind goes before a launch.

cards.name: Satellite Dish
cards.text: Listens to the sky next to the planetarium.

cards.name: Cloud
cards.text: Click it and it starts to rain.
